
### Install
1. Download **Satori.zip** below, unzip it, and drag **Satori.app** to Applications.
2. The first time, right-click **Satori.app → Open**. It isn't notarized, so macOS asks once.
   If it still won't open: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Satori.app`

Requires macOS 14+ on Apple silicon. Intel Macs can [build from source](https://github.com/emcee5000/satori#build-from-source).
